current_leader.name: Merchant settlement acceleration decision engine
current_leader.state_transition: processor balance eligible -> free payout ETA and paid speed tiers known -> external liquidity and obligations reveal actual shortfall -> choose zero/next-day/same-day/instant and minimum amount -> verify acceleration fees avoided
current_leader.why_survived: Fresh families tested in the 05:45 run did not beat it. Existing evidence still establishes recurring paid-speed events and deterministic marginal fees; exact cross-system minimum-necessary-acceleration decisioning remains unconfirmed. Leakage magnitude still lacks a merchant-level counterfactual dataset.
current_leader.strongest_evidence: Prior Adyen/Vagaro evidence establishes repeated instant-payout use; processor fee ladders make the financial delta deterministic.
current_leader.closest_threat: First-party payout controls plus treasury/cash forecasting can absorb the wedge; fee-free faster-access products neutralize it for subsets.
current_leader.smallest_intervention: Read PSP balances/ETAs/fee tiers, bank liquidity and obligations; recommend no acceleration or cheapest sufficient speed and minimum amount; no payout execution or custody.
current_leader.monetization: Small per valuable decision, low recurring micro-fee, or capped share of verified acceleration fees avoided versus competent cash management.
current_leader.biggest_unresolved_risk: Paid acceleration may be rational liquidity demand rather than waste; avoidable volume is still unquantified.
current_leader.next_research_test: Find merchant-level/anonymized evidence linking paid accelerated payouts to external liquidity and obligations, or an exact competitor combining those inputs. Kill if avoidable fraction is immaterial or exact functionality is found.

recent_cross_family_findings: AP unapplied vendor-credit auto-netting is rejected on Gate 8: current AP/recovery products already track, reconcile and automatically apply vendor credits.

Snowflake's daily cloud-services 10% threshold is a real programmable billing boundary, but first-party remediation and continuous Snowflake FinOps products make the timing wedge insufficiently distinct; demoted at 43/60.
CPaaS idle phone-number release is rejected: Twilio itself surfaces inactivity/traffic status, explicitly recommends release to stop MRCs, and exposes the deletion API.
Hotel OTA commission recovery for cancellations/no-shows is rejected again at the narrow event level because several exact products now audit and recover those charges.
New rule: when a first party exposes both the machine signal and exact cost-elimination action, require a materially richer cross-system decision or treat the wedge as a checkbox.
known_rejected_or_demoted_summary: Full historical rejection list is preserved in prior anchor blobs and immutable run files. Do not revive prior rejected families without materially new mechanism/evidence.
